Security Policy
DO NOT PUBLISH SECURITY REPORTS PUBLICLY.

If you believe you have found a security vulnerability in Sonata Admin, please report it through GitHub's Private Vulnerability Reporting.

Do not use the public issue tracker to report security vulnerabilities. Reports submitted through Private Vulnerability Reporting are confidential and will only be accessible to the repository maintainers.

Please provide as much information as possible to help us understand and reproduce the issue, including affected versions, steps to reproduce, and a proof of concept if available.

If you have any doubts about whether an issue has security implications, please report it privately.

The Sonata Project maintainers will assess the report and coordinate the investigation, resolution, and disclosure of confirmed vulnerabilities.

Please do not disclose the vulnerability publicly until a fix has been released and the maintainers have coordinated its disclosure.
